## How each MedDRA term of a split coarse construct was assigned

`override` is a row of configs/fine_construct_term_overrides.csv; `hpo vocabulary` means the term's words are a name or synonym in the construct's HPO expansion; `stem match` means the term shares word stems with the root's own name or synonyms; `namesake` means nothing decided and the term went to the coarse construct's namesake root. Move any of them with an override.
